nameEn: Manufacture of wearing apparel, except fur apparel
description: This class includes the manufacture of all types of wearing apparel (suits, coats, dresses, blouses, shirts, etc.) of any material (woven fabrics, knitted and crocheted fabrics, non-wovens, leather, etc.) and for all uses (men's, women's and children's apparel, work wear, outdoor clothing, etc.).
includes: manufacture of men's, boys', women's and girls' outerwear: suits, coats, overcoats, jackets, trousers, skirts, blouses, dresses
manufacture of work wear: uniforms, overalls, lab coats
manufacture of traditional costume, theatrical costume
manufacture of raincoats and other waterproof outerwear
manufacture of leather clothing and clothing accessories
excludes: manufacture of knitted and crocheted apparel, see 1430
manufacture of safety equipment such as fire-resistant and protective safety clothing, see 1410
tailoring and other custom manufacture, see 1410
